_note: Method per cohort for the trust-level tracker (Amendment 3, COFOUNDER-GRADER-2026-10-22.PREREG.md). A method is authoring brief + construction + author type (in-session / agent / model) + grader brief version; ANY change is a new method. 'unknown' is a legal value and is treated as a method of its own (a new method, so the batch gets a bridge spot). A cohort the tracker meets with no entry here and no verify_meta.method_id makes autonomy-state.mjs exit 2. New batches declare `verify_meta.method_id` on every row at insert; the tracker refuses if that disagrees with this table. Derived 2026-10-23 from verify_meta, the RELEASE preregs and REGISTER; `source` says where, `conflict` says where they disagree.

graderBriefs._note: cfg-v1 graded every batch staged so far. cfg-v2 was promoted to production by the feedback loop on 2026-10-23 (cofounder-loop-state.json validated_version v2): a batch pre-screened with it is a NEW method (method_id ending +cfg-v2), so its first batch in each stratum is a bridge spot.
